svg.title: Content Understanding RAG architecture
svg.desc: GitHub delivery control plane and Azure runtime for the workshop.
svg.text: Content Understanding RAG — GitHub delivery to Azure runtime
Reviewed change → required checks → CodeQL → OIDC release → grounded, citable answer
Browser → Frontend · user opens the console over HTTPS
Frontend → API · session cookie and upload init
API → Storage · metadata, quota and user-delegation SAS
Browser → Storage · direct Blob PUT of the file bytes
Storage → Worker · ingestion queue message under Blob lease
Worker → Foundry · analyze selected pages, then embed the chunks
Worker → AI Search · upsert 3,072-d vectors for the session
API → Foundry · question embedding and GPT-5 generation
AI Search → API · hybrid retrieval, top 8 evidence chunks
Cleanup → Storage · tombstone sweep of Blob and Search artifacts
